observations.statement: In Bengaluru Urban, Karnataka, 10 cases of fever with myalgia were reported from Village Kengeri, Sub-District Bengaluru South, and all 10 blood samples tested positive for Dengue by NS1 Antigen ELISA on 30-07-2026.
17 States-UTs submitted outbreak reports (including NIL reports) for the reporting period of 27th July 2026 to 2nd August 2026.
No States-UTs submitted 'NIL' outbreak reports for the period 27th July 2026 to 2nd August 2026.
The report does not provide outbreak data for all States-UTs, as only 17 submitted reports.
